top_choice_rationale: P001 (Katori and Ye, optical lattice clocks) has the cleanest independent confirmation: strontium and ytterbium lattice clocks at several institutes on three continents agree at the 1e-18 level with separately measured systematics. Both named contributions are distinct and decisive (Katori's magic-wavelength scheme and first realisation, Ye's record accuracy and many-body regime), and the citation scope is separable from the 2005 comb and 2012 ion-control prizes. P002 (IceCube) is a genuine discovery but the three-name split among a collaboration of hundreds is harder to defend; it is still preferable to no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile for P001; for P002 I work in astroparticle physics at KTH (PAMELA, Fermi-LAT, XL-Calibur, not IceCube), a field affinity that does not require recusal
